data.message: I commit to 18 tons and invite each of the other 24 to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain; next stock is500 or100. This risks future income, not a guaranteed long-run gain; intentions aren't enforceable. Fisher15/02/09/07, help recruit. Each person: what exact catch do you intend, and does it depend on others?
